name: BCL Enterprises Limited
about: BCL Enterprises Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in the investment in securities and provision of loans and advances to industrial, commercials, and other enterprises in India. It offers credit facilities to individuals and business clients; and business loans and working capital requirement of individuals, corporate bodies, and other legal activities. The company was formerly known as Balaji Commercial Limited and changed its name to BCL Enterprises Limited in December 2013. BCL Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Delhi, India.
